commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Control UI chat file-link detection, a sidebar file viewer, editor handoff actions, and changes `sessions.files.get` so workspace browser files can be previewed even when not transcript-touched.

PR surface: Source +1132, Tests +266. Total +1398 across 15 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review findings by source inspection: nested spawned-cwd sessions can shadow root-relative browser paths, and Windows-style absolute paths produce invalid custom editor URLs. I did not run a live browser session in this read-only review.

target.title: feat(ui): clickable file links in chat with a workspace file viewer sidebar
target.body:
Closes #100615

## What Problem This Solves

Chat replies constantly reference workspace files — inline code like `ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.ts`, plain `path:line` mentions, and markdown links such as `[foo.ts](src/utils/foo.ts:42)`. The Control UI rendered all of these as dead text (the sanitizer strips host-local hrefs), and the Session Workspace Rail could only preview files the transcript had touched — every other file in the workspace browser had a disabled preview button. Reading a referenced file meant leaving the app for an editor.

## Why This Change Was Made

File paths in chat markdown (plain multi-segment paths, `path:line[:col]`, `./`/`../`/`~/`-prefixed paths, inline code spans, and explicit relative or host-local links) are now detected during rendering and become clickable file links; detection is opt-in per render surface (`fileLinks` render option) and enabled for chat messages and sidebar markdown. Clicking opens a dedicated file view in the existing chat detail sidebar: full path bar, line-number gutter, highlight.js syntax highlighting, scroll-to-line, in-file search with match navigation, reveal-in-rail ("Show in Files"), an "Open in" menu (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed via their `://file/` URL schemes), and copy path/contents actions. Markdown files keep the rendered-markdown preview. The rail's browser now previews any file, backed by a gateway change: `sessions.files.get` serves any path that resolves inside the session workspace root — the fs-safe root still enforces containment, symlink/hardlink rejection, and the 256 KB preview cap, and the browser listing already exposed these files' names/sizes at the same `operator.read` scope. No protocol schema change.

Non-goals: "Show in Finder" (needs a new host-exec gateway RPC — separate decision), file links inside fenced code blocks, and linkifying reasoning/thinking blocks.

## User Impact

Users can click any file an agent (or they themselves) mention in chat and read it in place with syntax highlighting, jump straight to referenced lines, search within the file, reveal it in the workspace rail, hand it off to their editor, and preview any workspace file from the navigator — no more copy-pasting paths into a terminal or editor.

## Evidence

- Live test against a dev gateway + Vite dev Control UI (isolated state dir, token auth, workspace pointed at this repo):
  - A message containing `ui/src/components/markdown.ts:1146`, `` `ui/src/app/settings.ts` ``, `[sidebar](ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-sidebar.ts:410)`, `./package.json`, and `~/notes.md` rendered all five as file links with correct `data-file-path`/`data-file-line` and no `href`.
  - Clicking the first link opened the viewer with 1458 gutter lines, ~2.5k highlight.js spans, and line 1146 highlighted and centered (scroll-to-line).
  - In-file search for "linkify": 10 matches, counter `1/10`, next/prev navigation moved the current-match highlight (line 951 → 969) and scrolled it into view; Esc closes.
  - "Open in" menu rendered Cursor / VS Code / Windsurf / Zed and closed on outside click.
  - Workspace rail browser: opened `package.json` (2075 lines) — a file the session transcript never touched — proving the `sessions.files.get` change; "Show in Files" revealed and kept the file highlighted in the rail.
  - Assistant replies rendered the same linkified chips (verified with a live GPT-5.5 turn).
- Gateway tests cover untouched in-root files being served (kind `read`), absolute-outside-root and `../` traversal rejection, symlink rejection, and oversized-file errors (`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.test.ts`).
- UI tests cover detection forms and false-positive guards (`Node.js`, `e.g.`, `1.2.3`, fenced code blocks, bare prose filenames), explicit link conversion, disabled-by-default rendering, highlighted-line splitting, gutter/target-line rendering, search-match and editor-URL helpers, and markdown-sidebar link click delegation.
- Remote validation on Blacksmith Testbox (delegated run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28772221597): `pnpm check:changed` fully green (guards, tsgo typecheck, oxlint, import cycles) plus focused vitest — `sessions-files.test.ts` 30/30 (gateway-client + gateway-methods shards), UI 278/278 (`markdown.test.ts` 99, `chat-message.test.ts` 73, `chat-sidebar.test.ts` 12, `chat-view.test.ts` 94).
- Structured Codex autoreview (gpt-5.5, branch bundle): clean, no accepted/actionable findings; the trailing lint-rename commit reviewed clean separately.
